purpose: Regenerate only illustration source sheets that are unsuitable or risky for deterministic cropping.
global_crop_safe_lock: Create one illustration-only source sheet containing exactly the named assets for this page.
Use a pure white background and keep every named asset fully isolated inside its assigned zone.
Leave at least 10% canvas-width white gutter between neighbouring zones and at least 8% clear padding around every asset inside its zone.
No asset may touch, overlap, cast a merged shadow into, or visually contaminate another zone.
Do not optimise the source sheet as a decorative composition; optimise it for deterministic cropping reliability.

Do not include worksheet frames, cards, panels, dotted boxes, response circles, answer boxes, sequence slots, matching lines, arrows, route lines, comparison symbols, crossed-out objects, labels, titles, instructions, branding, page numbers or teacher cues.
Do not include generated words or numerals unless the numeral is explicitly named as an asset.
Keep grouped quantities compact, countable and entirely inside one zone; do not scatter loose objects near zone edges.
Premium preschool-publishing quality, large recognisable forms, thick clean rounded outlines, refined flat colour, minimal detail, no photorealism, no watermark, no mockup.
